shortThesis: CivicState is a built civic-letter utility, but investibility waits on identity, demand, delivery, and citation proof.

thesisCurrent: As of 2026-06-23 [evidence: session current date], the repo implements CivicState civic-letter software, but the investible thesis is conditional on paid demand, deliverability, citation quality, and operator identity ruling.

snapshot.oneLine: Built civic-letter app; not yet investible until beta proof and registry identity are resolved.
snapshot.currentRisk: No live revenue, users, deliverability, or market proof found in workspace [assumption: absence of production artifacts].

customerDefinition: Primary customer is a United States resident with a concrete civic concern who will pay for research, official targeting, drafting, and delivery rather than doing it manually [assumption: inferred from product and plan].

marketSizing.method: Bottom-up wedge model, not top-down TAM.
marketSizing.localWedge: 240 annual paid submissions and $3,360 annual gross revenue [assumption: 10 niches times 100 monthly visitors times 2.0% conversion times 12 months times $14 AOV].
marketSizing.regionalWedge: 3,000 annual paid submissions and $42,000 annual gross revenue [assumption: 50 niches times 250 monthly visitors times 2.0% conversion times 12 months times $14 AOV].
marketSizing.matureNiche: 24,000 annual paid submissions and $336,000 annual gross revenue [assumption: 200 niches times 500 monthly visitors times 2.0% conversion times 12 months times $14 AOV].
marketSizing.vcRead: Useful if validated, not yet a venture-scale case by itself [assumption: funding-fit judgment].

revenueModel.marginPolicy: Underwrite 70% gross margin until live costs are measured [assumption: risk-adjusted policy]; prior plan claims 91% gross margin [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md as prior-plan claim].

financialFigures: $96 per month planned droplet cost [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md stated constraint]

goToMarket.nearTerm: Closed beta before SEO or public campaign publishing.
goToMarket.wedge: 3 narrow issue categories first [assumption: focused validation design].
goToMarket.beta: 30 testers and 20 paid submissions [assumption: validation target].
channels: SEO only after successful beta and legal/privacy review [assumption]

holes: Demand may be too weak because manual outreach is free [assumption: demand risk].
Government email deliverability may fail [assumption: delivery risk].
Citation defects could create user harm or reputational damage [assumption: compliance risk].
Registry identity mismatch could make the asset unpitchable until resolved [evidence: dispatch versus source tree].
mitigations: Closed beta with paid checkout before public launch [assumption].
Human review of every beta letter before delivery [assumption].
Require operator ruling on CivicState versus Brooks History framing [assumption].
Refresh market and competitor evidence with network sources before investor publication [assumption].
residualRisks: Even validated beta demand may not imply repeatable acquisition [assumption].
Legal/compliance boundaries may require counsel and higher operating cost [assumption].
A small validated niche may still be non-venture-scale [assumption].
